sitecheck.label: Website address
sitecheck.hint: Type a domain or paste a full address. Toolland opens the home page once, like a normal visitor.
sitecheck.cert.subject: Issued to
sitecheck.techNone: No known technology was recognised on the home page. The site may leave no traces of its stack, or it may refuse automated visitors.
sitecheck.techNote: Inferred from the headers, cookies, and HTML of the home page. Server technology that is hidden will not show up.
sitecheck.note: This is a passive check of the home page only, not a full security audit. Grades can differ from other tools because they weigh things differently.
sitecheck.check.https.pass: The site loads over an encrypted connection.
sitecheck.check.https.fail: The site still loads over plain http without encryption, so visitor data can be intercepted.
sitecheck.fix.https: Install a free SSL certificate (for example Let's Encrypt or Cloudflare) and send every visitor to https.
sitecheck.check.redirect.pass: http:// addresses are redirected to https:// automatically.
sitecheck.check.redirect.fail: http:// is not redirected to https://, so visitors can keep using an unencrypted connection.
sitecheck.check.redirect.info: Not graded because the site does not use https yet.
sitecheck.check.redirect.info.closed: Port 80 (http) is closed, so there is no unencrypted path.
sitecheck.fix.redirect: Add a permanent (301) redirect from http to https on the server or CDN.
sitecheck.check.cert.pass: The certificate is valid, {days} days left.
sitecheck.check.cert.warn: The certificate is about to expire: {days} days left.
sitecheck.check.cert.fail.expired: The certificate has expired. Browsers show a red warning to visitors.
sitecheck.check.cert.fail.name: The certificate does not match this domain name. Browsers show a warning to visitors.
sitecheck.check.cert.fail.issuer: The certificate is not issued by a trusted authority (self-signed) or its chain is incomplete.
sitecheck.check.cert.fail.other: The certificate was rejected during verification.
sitecheck.fix.cert: Renew the certificate and make sure automatic renewal is on. If the chain is incomplete, also install the intermediate certificate.
sitecheck.check.tls.fail: Uses {version}, which is outdated and insecure.
sitecheck.fix.tls: Enable only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 in the server settings.
sitecheck.check.hsts.pass: Browsers are told to always use https for {days} days.
sitecheck.check.hsts.warn: HSTS is on but only for {days} days. At least 180 days is recommended.
sitecheck.check.hsts.fail: No Strict-Transport-Security header, so a first visit over http can still be hijacked.
sitecheck.fix.hsts: Add the header Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
sitecheck.check.csp.pass: A CSP restricts which scripts may run, making XSS attacks harder.
sitecheck.check.csp.warn.partial: There is a CSP, but it does not restrict scripts (no script-src or default-src) or is report-only.
sitecheck.check.csp.warn.unsafe: The CSP still allows 'unsafe-inline' scripts, so XSS protection is weak.
sitecheck.check.csp.fail: No CSP. If there is an XSS hole, attacker scripts can run freely.
sitecheck.fix.csp: Start with a Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only header to see the impact, then enforce script-src 'self' plus the domains you really use.
sitecheck.check.frame.pass: The site cannot be silently embedded in another site's iframe.
sitecheck.check.frame.warn: The site can be loaded in another site's iframe (no X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors).
sitecheck.fix.frame: Add the header X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.
sitecheck.check.nosniff.pass: Browsers do not guess file types (nosniff).
sitecheck.check.nosniff.warn: The X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header is missing.
sitecheck.check.referrer.pass: Full page addresses do not leak to other sites when visitors click links.
sitecheck.check.referrer.warn: Referrer-Policy is not set or is too loose.
sitecheck.check.permissions.pass: Access to sensitive features such as camera, microphone, and location is restricted.
sitecheck.check.permissions.info: Not set. Optional, useful for turning off browser features you do not use.
sitecheck.check.cookies.pass: All cookies ({n}) use the Secure flag.
sitecheck.fix.cookies: Set the Secure attribute on every cookie, and HttpOnly on session cookies.
sitecheck.check.disclosure.pass: The server does not advertise its software name and version.
sitecheck.check.disclosure.warn: Headers reveal the software in use ({values}). Attackers can look up holes for that version.
sitecheck.fix.disclosure: Hide versions: server_tokens off in Nginx, ServerTokens Prod in Apache, expose_php = Off in PHP, and remove X-Powered-By.
sitecheck.check.mixed.pass: No scripts, images, or CSS are loaded over http on the https page.
sitecheck.check.mixed.warn: Some resources are loaded over http:// on the https page. Browsers may block them.
sitecheck.fix.mixed: Change every http:// address in the HTML to https://.
sitecheck.check.securitytxt.pass: There is a /.well-known/security.txt for reporting security holes.
sitecheck.check.securitytxt.info: Missing. Optional: it lists a contact for people who find security holes.
sitecheck.fix.securitytxt: Create /.well-known/security.txt with a Contact: line (see securitytxt.org).
sitecheck.check.spf.pass: There is an SPF record, so not just any server may send email for this domain.
sitecheck.check.spf.warn: No SPF record. Fake email from this domain gets through more easily.
sitecheck.check.spf.fail.open: SPF ends with +all or ?all, so any server may send email for this domain.
sitecheck.fix.spf: Add a TXT record like v=spf1 include:your-email-provider ~all, or v=spf1 -all if the domain sends no email.
sitecheck.check.dmarc.pass: DMARC is on with the {policy} policy.
sitecheck.check.dmarc.warn.none: DMARC only monitors (p=none), so fake email is still accepted.
sitecheck.fix.dmarc: Add a TXT record at _dmarc with v=DMARC1; p=quarantine, then raise it to p=reject once you are confident.
sitecheck.check.caa.pass: Only specific authorities may issue certificates for this domain.
sitecheck.check.caa.info: No CAA record. Optional: it limits who may issue certificates.
sitecheck.fix.caa: Add a CAA record, for example 0 issue "letsencrypt.org".
sitecheck.error.invalid: That is not a valid website address. Example: example.com
sitecheck.error.blocked: This address points to a local or private network, so it cannot be checked.
sitecheck.error.unreachable: The website could not be opened. Check the address and make sure the site is online.
sitecheck.error.timeout: The website took too long to answer. Some sites also deliberately stall automated visitors.
sitecheck.error.busy: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
sitecheck.error.rate_limit: Too many checks from your connection. Wait a minute and try again.
sitecheck.error.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.
sitecheck.error.upstream: Something went wrong during the check. Try again.

iq.kindOddDesc: Spot the one that doesn't fit
iq.rule1: 30 questions in 20 minutes, getting harder as you go.
iq.rule2: Questions are generated at random every time, so they can't be memorised.
iq.rule3: Right or wrong isn't shown per question; you only see the final score.
iq.rule4: You may skip questions and come back using the numbers at the top.
iq.disclaimer: This result is an estimate for practice and fun, not an official IQ test. A valid IQ test is given by a psychologist using a normed instrument. Scores can vary with tiredness, focus, and familiarity with similar puzzles.
iq.promptOdd: Which figure is different from the others?
iq.keysHint: Shortcuts: 1-6 or A-F to choose, ← → to move between questions.
iq.timeUp: Time is up. Unanswered questions count as wrong.
iq.curveTitle: Where you sit on the IQ distribution (mean 100, SD 15)
iq.reportError: Could not create the file. Please try again.
iq.reportFooter: Made with the IQ Test at {site}
persona.keysHint: Tip: press 1-5 to answer and ← to go back. Progress is saved automatically in this browser.
persona.discPrompt: Pick the word that is MOST like you (+) and the one that is LEAST like you (−).
persona.discHint: Once you pick + and −, the next group appears automatically. Progress is saved in this browser.
persona.reportError: Could not create the file. Please try again.
ocr.hint: Works with photos, screenshots, and scanned PDFs (up to 30 pages). Paste a screenshot directly with Ctrl+V. Images are processed on your device and never uploaded.
ocr.tooManyPages: {name}: only the first {n} pages are read.
ocr.markLow: Highlight uncertain words on the image
ocr.noText: No text could be read. Try a brighter, straighter photo, or rotate the image.
ocr.failed: Couldn't read this image. Try another one or reload the page.
ocr.firstLoad: On first use your browser downloads the OCR engine and language data (about 6 MB). After that it is cached and much faster.
prompter.fileErr: The file can't be read. Use TXT, DOCX, ODT, or PDF.
prompter.stage: Teleprompter area, click to play or pause
prompter.keys: Shortcuts: Space play/pause · ↑ ↓ speed · ← → back/forward · R restart · F full screen. While paused, scroll with the mouse wheel or swipe.
prompter.sample:
Welcome to the Toolland Teleprompter.

Paste your script in the box above, set the speed and font size, then press Start or the Space bar.

Read the text as it passes the yellow line. Look at the camera, breathe, and speak naturally.

Use mirror mode when the screen is reflected onto teleprompter glass.

Press F for full screen. Happy recording!
prompter.videoDesc: Turn this scrolling text into an MP4 video, for example to play on a separate teleprompter screen or to overlay in another video. It uses the settings above (speed, size, theme, mirror, reading line).
prompter.videoTooLong: The video is too long (20 minutes max). Increase the speed or shorten the script.
prompter.videoUnsupported: Your browser can't create videos yet. Try the latest Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
prompter.videoFailed: Couldn't create the video. Try another size or reload the page.
